selection_rule: Choose the latest two eligible merged PRs per feature, bugfix, and refactor category. If at least four of the initial six have unknowable chronology, add the next eligible PR per category, capped at nine per repository.
candidate_queries: repo:OpenHands/OpenHands is:pr is:merged merged:>=2024-09-12 label:"type: refactor"
repo:SWE-agent/SWE-agent is:pr is:merged merged:>=2024-09-12 (feat OR enh OR add OR support) in:title
repo:SWE-agent/SWE-agent is:pr is:merged merged:>=2024-09-12 (simplify OR move OR cleanup OR restructure OR ref) in:title
repo:obra/superpowers is:pr is:merged merged:>=2024-09-12 feat in:title
repo:obra/superpowers is:pr is:merged merged:>=2024-09-12 refactor in:title
exclusion_policy: release automation or aggregate release vehicle
issue-template, code-of-conduct, or repository administration with no product implementation

representative_exclusions.reason: docs, CI housekeeping, or release automation
docs-only, automated hook/dependency upkeep, or warning copy rather than an implementation feature
issue-template metadata, aggregate release vehicle, docs-only, or code-of-conduct administration

limitations: GitHub search counts are broad candidate counts before manual category and exclusion review.
Labels were used where maintained; otherwise title, body, and diff purpose were inspected manually.
A same-commit result cannot reveal local edit or execution order, especially after squash or rebase.
